scriptLines: VehiculoId = iif(     isNull(VehiculoId) || trim(VehiculoId) == '',     toString(null()),     iif(         regexMatch(upper(trim(VehiculoId)), '^V-\\d{3}$'),         upper(trim(VehiculoId)),         iif(             regexMatch(trim(VehiculoId), '^\\d{1,3}$'),             concat('V-', lpad(trim(VehiculoId), 3, '0')),             toString(null())         )     ) ),

FechaHoraInicio = iif(     isNull(FIniF) || trim(FIniF) == '',     toTimestamp(null()),     toTimestamp(         concat(             toString(                 iif(                     regexMatch(trim(FIniF), '^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$'),                     addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(regexExtract(trim(FIniF), '(\\d+)', 1))),                     iif(                         instr(trim(FIniF), '/') > 0,                         toDate(left(trim(FIniF), 10), 'dd/MM/yyyy'),                         toDate(left(trim(FIniF), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd')                     )                 ),                 'yyyy-MM-dd'             ),             ' ',             iif(isNull(FIniH) || trim(FIniH) == '', '00:00:00', concat(trim(FIniH), ':00')),             ''         ),         'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'     ) ),

FechaHoraFin = iif(     isNull(FFinF) || trim(FFinF) == '',     toTimestamp(null()),     toTimestamp(         concat(             toString(                 iif(                     regexMatch(trim(FFinF), '^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$'),                     addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(regexExtract(trim(FFinF), '(\\d+)', 1))),                     iif(                         instr(trim(FFinF), '/') > 0,                         toDate(left(trim(FFinF), 10), 'dd/MM/yyyy'),                         toDate(left(trim(FFinF), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd')                     )                 ),                 'yyyy-MM-dd'             ),             ' ',             iif(isNull(FFinH) || trim(FFinH) == '', '00:00:00', concat(trim(FFinH), ':00')),             ''         ),         'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'     ) ),

FechaHoraRegistro = iif(     isNull(FRegF) || trim(FRegF) == '',     toTimestamp(null()),     toTimestamp(         concat(             toString(                 iif(                     regexMatch(trim(FRegF), '^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$'),                     addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(regexExtract(trim(FRegF), '(\\d+)', 1))),                     iif(                         instr(trim(FRegF), '/') > 0,                         toDate(left(trim(FRegF), 10), 'dd/MM/yyyy'),                         toDate(left(trim(FRegF), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd')                     )                 ),                 'yyyy-MM-dd'             ),             ' ',             iif(isNull(FRegH) || trim(FRegH) == '', '00:00:00', concat(trim(FRegH), ':00')),             ''         ),         'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'     ) )) ~> limpiar
